rationale: Several papers contribute substantive new evidence on testing modified gravity theories against observational data. Papers [2010.13838] and [1804.04582] discuss specific models and their observational implications, [1812.08244] reports an experimental test, [2002.06381] provides measurements of the Hubble constant in modified gravity contexts, and [1808.00377] explores distinguishing modified gravity from dark energy using growth index reconstruction. However, the question is not fully settled.
